req.title: Task update persists
req.statement: The system shall persist PUT changes so subsequent GET requests reflect the update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that updates to tasks via the PUT endpoint should be persisted and reflected in subsequent GET requests. This necessitates testing for successful updates, handling of non-existent tasks, and boundary conditions such as minimal valid updates.

tests.name: test_update_task_success
preconditions: A task with id 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the task with id 1.
expected: The response payload reflects the updated task details.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()

# Update the task
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{created_task['id']}", json={"title": "Updated Task", "description": "Updated Description", "completed": True})
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()

# Verify the update
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Task"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Updated Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_update_nonexistent_task
preconditions: No task with id 999 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update a non-existent task with id 999.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to update a non-existent task
update_response = client.put("/tasks/999", json={"title": "Non-existent Task", "description": "This task does not exist", "completed": False})
assert update_response.status_code == 404
assert "Task with id 999 not found" in update_response.json()['detail']

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary
preconditions: A task with id 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the task with id 1 with minimal valid data.
expected: The response payload reflects the updated task with minimal changes.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()

# Update the task with minimal valid data
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{created_task['id']}", json={"title": "B"})
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()

# Verify the update
assert updated_task['title'] == "B"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Boundary Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is False
